say:2:1222713002:1.text: I've figured it out: the golden peacock does eat gold, but gold isn't its only food.
say:2:1222713002:1.source_cn: 我已经搞清楚了，黄金孔雀确实会吃金子，但金子不是它们唯...

say:3:1222713003:1.text: To be more precise, they only eat gold under certain conditions. And I'm still working on what constitutes those conditions.
say:3:1222713003:1.source_cn: 嗯，应该说，它们只有在特定条件下才会吃金子。至于究竟怎...

say:4:1222713004:1.text: How they digest the gold is also something worth exploring. My next paper will focus on this topic.
say:4:1222713004:1.source_cn: 除此之外，它们怎么消化这些金子也是个值得关注的大问题，...

say:5:1222713005:1.text: If I write it well, my paper might even get featured in the top journal of the Evergreen Conservatory! Then I'll get more research funding! Haha!
say:5:1222713005:1.source_cn: 要是写得好的话，说不定还能登上冬青学会的顶刊呢！到时候...
